evidence.detail: The constructor stores start/end sprite-frame indices and initializes currentFrame=start; a() increments currentFrame and wraps to start after end.

R55 RSFont resolves these definitions from rs/l/j by inline icon id, selects the current sprite from the client text-icon sprite table, and reads additional definition integers as icon placement/spacing adjustments during rich-text layout and drawing.
R74 ItemIconOverlay resolves TEXT_ICON overlays through the same rs/l/j definition map and uses currentFrame to select the live client text-icon sprite.

rs/l/j populates the definition map with explicit icon-id to sprite-frame ranges such as 21 -> 27..30, 32 -> 33..36, 45 -> 41..44 and multiple 333+ animated ranges, with fluent per-icon offsets/spacing.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one animated inline text-icon definition. The six additional integers are retained generically as presentation adjustments rather than over-named.

evidence.detail: The class owns the int-keyed rs/l/a/a AnimatedTextIconDefinition map used by RSFont and ItemIconOverlay, plus icon-id arrays and resource lookup helpers for icons/, clan/icons/ and popup icon families.
It owns the String->Integer color map and exact markup tokens including red, gre, blu, cya, mag, whi, yel, lre, dre, or0..or3, gr1..gr3 and additional hexadecimal colors.
Its helpers parse color text, classify icon ids, strip classic <...>/@...@ markup with regex, and expose icon/color lookup behavior consumed by the rich-text renderer.
Static initialization constructs the animated inline-icon definitions and derives the registered icon-id set used by RSFont's icon width/drawing paths.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared rich-text markup/color/inline-icon registry. It is broader than an icon-only cache and narrower than the RSFont renderer itself.
